subject: maths
question: If 10% of A = B, then B% of 20 is the same as:
solution:
**Given:**10% of A = B

**Calculation:**

A x 10/100 = B

⇒ B = A/10

Now,

⇒ B% of 20 = (A)/(10) times (1)/(100) times 20

⇒ B% of 20 = {A} times (2)/(100)

**∴ B% of 20 = 2% of A.**
